name: petclinic-node
description: Spring PetClinic equivalent in Node.js with Express.js and PostgreSQL

scripts.db:init:postgres: psql -U petclinic -d petclinic -h localhost -f db/postgres/schema.sql && psql -U petclinic -d petclinic -h localhost -f db/postgres/data.sql
scripts.db:init:mysql: mysql -u petclinic -ppetclinic -h localhost petclinic < db/mysql/schema.sql && mysql -u petclinic -ppetclinic -h localhost petclinic < db/mysql/data.sql

author: Google Senior Engineer
